lines.text: [laughs softly] Walaw, you think I can't hear you through that wall? Plaster on lath, habibi. [whispering] I hear everything... even the things you whisper to yourself.
[sighs] Yaani... it's two in the morning and you're still awake. [teasing] Come to the landing. Don't knock. [low and breathy] Just stand there and let me decide.
